title: YieldVault Transaction Event Payload
description: The `payload` object carried by every transaction.* webhook envelope. Shape is identical for transaction.deposit.created and transaction.withdrawal.created. Source of truth: TransactionEventPayload in backend/src/webhookDelivery.ts.

transactionId.description: Unique identifier for the transaction record.

amount.description: Amount in the asset's smallest unit (stroops for USDC, 10^6 = 1 USDC), encoded as a decimal string to avoid precision loss for large values.

walletAddress.description: Stellar account address (StrKey "G...") of the depositor/withdrawer.

transactionHash.description: Hash of the on-chain Stellar transaction that triggered this event.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the transaction was recorded.
